title: Le Petit Prince (LPP) Multi-talker: Naturalistic 7T fMRI and EEG Dataset
description: A naturalistic multi-talker listening dataset in which 25 native Mandarin speakers underwent both 7T fMRI and 64-channel EEG while listening to the Chinese version of Le Petit Prince. Conditions included single-talker and mixed-talker speech with attention directed to different talkers, with comprehension quizzes after each run. The dataset supports research on speech perception, selective attention, and language processing under naturalistic conditions.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel actiCAP system at 500 Hz (0.016-80 Hz filter). fMRI was acquired on a 7T Siemens Terra scanner (85 interleaved axial slices, 1.6 mm isotropic voxels, TR = 1000 ms, TE = 22.2 ms) with T1-weighted MP-RAGE anatomical scans (0.7 mm isotropic). MRI data were converted with dcm2niix and preprocessed with fMRIPrep 20.2.0, including multi-echo ICA denoising.
